title_en: SWELL: an expansion microscope designed to be cheap
title_zh: SWELL：以低成本为目标的膨胀显微镜
description_en: Invention #1: an automated expansion-microscopy imager for chicken muscle, designed to be cheap. Designed and simulated on paper, never built, free to take; the instrument is for building in an equipped workshop or lab, by adults.
description_zh: 发明一号：一台以鸡肉为样本、以低成本为目标设计的自动膨胀显微镜。只在纸上设计和模拟过，从未造出来，免费拿去用；仪器只适合由成年人在设备齐全的工坊或实验室里造。
